Third, Ravi -- please formally circulate the compliance memo and begin drafting the related-party disclosure. I will not authorize submission of a binding bid until all three sign-offs are complete, the tape is updated, the recovery model is recalibrated and attached, and the bid package includes both the related-party disclosure and independent valuation. Let's regroup before end of day with updates on each track.
